slug.description: Stable kebab-case identifier of the move.

game.description: Folder slug of the game this move belongs to.

moveType.description: Key declared in the game's move type vocabulary.

audience.description: Optional audience that owns this move; MC moves use `mc`.

playbook.description: Playbook slug when the move belongs to one.

rollType.description: Game stat key, `formula`, or `none` describing how the move rolls.

rollFormula.description: Explicit roll formula when rollType is `formula`.

rollMod.description: Signed 32-bit modifier added to the roll.

results.description: Outcome entries keyed by the game's roll result vocabulary.

label.description: Human-readable label for this result tier.

text.description: Plain-text outcome for this result tier.

additionalProperties.description: One possible outcome of a move roll.

uses.description: Available uses, stored as an unsigned 32-bit count.

choices.description: Choice instructions attached to the move.

tags.description: Free-form tags attached to the move.

title: PbtA move
description: Portable representation of a Powered by the Apocalypse move.
